updateWebhook.description: Edit or disable a webhook subscription. Verify with control.webhooks.list.

viewPageContent.name: control.spaces.pages.content.get
viewPageContent.description: Read one bounded content snapshot and its strong ETag together. Use this content baseline for edit/revert; summary and full-detail responses are not the new editing baseline.

batchGetPages.name: control.spaces.pages.batchGet
batchGetPages.description: Read 1..100 selected Pages in one Space without business writes, despite POST. Choose summary or content; inaccessible and absent IDs both return not_found. Content results carry per-page baseline ETags. Duplicate IDs and responses above 4 MiB are rejected; reduce the batch or use summary.

publishPages.name: control.spaces.pages.batchPublish
publishPages.description: Publish 1..100 selected authored Pages in one atomic Space operation, with at most one automatic Release. Any authorization failure rejects the whole batch. Outcome held means page selection committed but the live Release did not advance; Site delivery remains separate.

unpublishPages.name: control.spaces.pages.batchUnpublish
unpublishPages.description: Unpublish 1..100 selected authored Pages in one atomic Space operation, with at most one automatic Release. Any authorization failure rejects the whole batch. Verify selected Page states, actual Release outcome, and Site delivery only when requested.

replaceCurrentUser.name: control.account.replace
replaceCurrentUser.description: Replace the authenticated user profile with a complete representation. Every declared profile field, including nullable locale and avatar, must be supplied; null clears the value. Verify with control.account.get.
